items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: We could get Frankie Trumbauer in the middle of the day.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Those people, they came on in the morning. And then in the late afternoon we could get Guy Lombardo. We could get Frankie Trumbauer in the middle of the day. Are you familiar with Frankie Trumbauer, the C-melody saxophone player? We could get his band in the middle of the day. And then we could get Wayne King around about six o'clock. And in fact, his theme song was the first song I really learned how to play; "The Waltz You Sing For Me" was Wayne King's theme song. And he had a saxophone
